verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for all services.

maxconn.description: Global maximum number of concurrent connections across all services.

default_user.description: Default system user to run services as when not specified per-service.

default_group.description: Default system group to run services as when not specified per-service.

timeout_dns.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for DNS lookups before timing out.

timeout_idle.description: Idle timeout in seconds for TCP connections before closing them.

ipv6.description: Enable listening on IPv6 addresses where supported.

services.description: List of services to manage (e.g., ftp, telnet, http). Each defines a daemon.

user.description: User to run the service as (overrides default_user).

group.description: Group to run the service as (overrides default_group).

log_prefix.description: Prefix for log lines (helps identify service in logs).

cmd.description: Command and arguments to execute when service is triggered.
